comparison.objective: Route a flexible lamp cable into a holder while keeping it clear of a hot plate.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable cable routing and whole-body keep-out management.
comparison.success_condition: Plug seated and released, cable on table ≥5 cm from hot plate for 1 s; any passage over the plate latches zero.
comparison.reason: Tests flexible-object routing around a hazard, not rigid many-body separation.
